{{TAGDEF|LNMRCAR|.TRUE. {{!}} .FALSE.|.TRUE.}}

Description: Write the {{FILE|NMRCAR.magres}} file for [[calculating the electric field gradient|EFG calculations]] and [[Calculating the chemical shieldings|chemical shielding calculations]].
----

When [[calculating the chemical shieldings]] or [[calculating the electric field gradient]], {{TAG|LNMRCAR|T}} writes the {{FILE|NMRCAR.magres}} in [https://www.ccpnc.ac.uk/docs/magres  Magres format]. Mind that, while the Magres format does not clearly state if the [[:Category:NMR#Magnetic_susceptibility|macroscopic susceptibility]] should be included, here it is included in the chemical shielding.
